verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is about avoiding upload: Semgrep analyzes code locally and by default never uploads it, and the `--dry-run` flag keeps scan results out of the Semgrep web app. That lets a user minimize what data the vendor holds, but nothing documents retention or deletion controls for data the AppSec Platform does store (CI scans send findings there). Missing for 10: configurable retention periods, a documented process to delete findings, projects or account data, independent corroboration of these controls.
